organization.name: Calendly LLC
organization.notes: Tope Awotona founded Calendly in 2013 initially using personal savings. Current investor portfolio pages verify OpenView and ICONIQ backing; funding status is not inferred from its initially self-funded origin. No exchange listing or parent established; private company classification follows investor portfolio context. Exact cumulative raise not asserted.

pricingTiers.name: Standard
pricingTiers.notes: Lowest paid scheduling plan; Free separate. Yearly-billed $10/seat/month multiplied by 12. Optional Notetaker/Callie add-ons excluded.

pricingTiers.name: Teams
pricingTiers.notes: Explicit Popular plan badge. Yearly-billed $16/seat/month multiplied by 12; optional add-ons separate.

pricingTiers.name: Teams
pricingTiers.notes: Named team plan; yearly-billed $16/seat/month multiplied by 12.

pricingTiers.name: Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Starts at $15,000/year for organization; starts at 50 seats, USD only. This is a contract starting total, not $15,000 per seat.

moats.claim: Widely shared booking links and a large integration ecosystem support distribution and embedded workflow switching costs; scheduling itself remains replicable.

productReasons.claim: Round-robin scheduling and qualification routing distribute incoming meetings across a team.
Multiple calendar conflict checks and automated reminders coordinate availability and reduce manual follow-up.
Stripe and PayPal connections collect payments as part of the booking workflow.
